selection.policy: Select one mjs block per mjs/cjs pair for distinct classical key operations; full three standardized PQC key generation tests; exclude key bytes/derivation example

countRationale: Initial breadth across language, input formats, boundary cases and new independent authorship. Counts reflect reviewable distinct cases, not a 300-500 target.
